params.prompt: A cinematic painterly harbor at sunset made of layered folded paper: small paper sailboats bob gently on paper waves, their sails swaying softly in a light breeze, warm orange lantern lights twinkle along the quay, the sky glows with dusk orange and teal. The camera drifts slowly to the right with a gentle parallax. The camera moves very slowly and smoothly. The scene stays bright and well lit, with natural colors matching the first frame. No text, no people in close-up, nothing morphs, shapes stay stable and solid.
